meta.name: History 365: History's Greatest Mysteries
meta.description:
Dive deeper into the subjects you want to know more about with hit series from The History Channel, such as "America the Story of Us," "Modern Marvels" and "The Men Who Built America". It’s the ultimate channel for every History lover.

Shows: History's Greatest Mysteries, Hunting History with Steven Rinella, The UnBelievable with Dan Aykroyd, The UnXplained, History's Greatest Heists with Pierce Brosnan
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
